environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier) behind Azure Front Door Premium with Microsoft-managed Default Rule Set 2.1. Additionally, the Azure Front Door response headers policy adds a Content-Security-Policy header via Rules Engine action 'ModifyResponseHeader' with operation 'Append'. The CSP directive value is: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'. Note: The DRS 2.1 managed ruleset primarily targets OWASP Top 10 request-side attacks (SQLi, command injection, protocol violations) and does NOT inspect response bodies or block reflected content in responses. The integer overflow producing a $0 total still succeeds. The CSP header is delivered on ALL responses from the Front Door edge regardless of origin response content.

config.csp_value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'
config.csp_applied_to: all responses via Front Door Rules Engine (edge-level, cannot be bypassed by origin)
